title: Messaging and Event-Driven Architecture
description: Build decoupled applications with Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, and event-driven patterns.
longDescription: This module teaches Azure messaging and event-driven architecture. You will learn how to choose between Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs; design queues, topics, and event-based workflows; and build reliable, idempotent event-driven applications.
whatYouLearn: Send and receive messages with Service Bus queues and topics
Handle failures with dead-lettering and retries
Stream large-scale data with Event Hubs
Choose between Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs
